title: Why AI Agents Broke Out of the Chatbox
description:
Agents look like a sudden product category, but the real shift was architectural: language models stopped answering and started operating.

This cinematic brief compresses the transition from chat interfaces to autonomous systems that plan, act, recover, and collaborate under real-world constraints.

The goal is to hook viewers on the structural shift, then push them toward the full research breakdown behind modern agent design.
